entities.summary: Yirmisekizzade Mehmed Said Pasha, earlier in his life known as Mehmed Said Efendi, was an Ottoman statesman and diplomat. He was Grand Vizier of the Ottoman Empire from October 25, 1755, to April 1, 1756.
